action_items: Update Guide copy on /games/stopwatch: 'Home = Fixed Challenge' is outdated now that /home is the Games Hub. Either move Guide to Games Hub or re-word to 'Fixed Challenge' only (no 'Home =').
(Nice-to-have) Fix pre-existing login country <option><span> hydration warning by rendering flag as text instead of span.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py gen_crash_point: ~5% instant crash at 1.00 implemented via `if r < he: return 1.00` — matches spec; good.
Aviator cashout server_mult uses LATENCY_BOUND to bound claimed multiplier; properly rejects over-claims via min(claimed, server_mult). Secure.
Tower bombs_layout returned only on terminal state (bomb hit / finish / cashout) — correct info-hiding during play.

/games/aviator/start returns crash_point to client (as expected for client-side animation) which the frontend uses in canvas.fly(); server still re-validates on cashout, so no cheat risk, but worth documenting that this is intentional design.
AviatorCanvas computes server_elapsed on cashout from server_start timestamp, enforcing realism — good.
Minor: Aviator session created even if debit_wallet fails before insert — code order looks ok (debit before insert), but if debit raises, no session leak occurs. OK.
Pre-existing: Some callers to credit_wallet pass str user_id and others ObjectId — currently handled, but keeping types consistent would be cleaner.
